title: Today, after-sales service <1>doesn't work as a system</1>.

items.d: Fragmented operations, blurred ownership, escalations that get lost.
Siloed data. No real traceability between case, execution and closure.
Assignments by geography or rate, not by real capability or product knowledge.
End customers don't know what's happening with their case. Neither do you.

result: Result: <1>higher cost · more incidents · worse experience.</1>
